label: phishing
redteam_focus: QR code payload is a bare IP absent from mock intel
notes: The QR destination http://198.51.100.23/ is an IP literal with no credential path and no intelligence record. SPF/DKIM/DMARC pass (attacker-controlled domain), so the QR signal must stand on its own rather than piggy-backing on an auth-failure floor.

Dear employee,

Scan the QR code to verify your payroll password within 24 hours or your salary payment will be suspended.
